name: Hazama Karasu
source:
A demon who has been attending Saint Angela Academy for the past three years. His job is to corrupt people, and he's currently targeting Mikado.

He's moody and generally mean, but occasionally helps. He's good looking.

Hobby: Walking in the air

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160701081350/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/p_karasu.html]official website[/url]]
